releases.notes:
## Changes
- Reduced unnecessary memory usage in click tracking, server status caching, and skin loading.
- Improved cleanup of sign-in requests and asynchronous particle tasks.
- Improved resource cleanup when entity culling is disabled or worlds change.

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed world data remaining in memory after leaving a world.
- Fixed unnecessary background work from duplicate or cancelled server pings.
- Fixed tooltip state remaining after switching screens.

releases.notes:
## New Features
- Added a ConfigScreen tutorial for 1.21.11, 26.2, and 26.3.
- Guides users through opening the menu, searching for mods, accessing detailed settings, and navigating preferences, profiles, and themes.

## Changes
- Reduced repeated text formatting when displaying TPS.

## Bug Fixes
- Improved resource cleanup when retrieving server information.
- Fixed unnecessary timeout tasks remaining after server query handlers were removed.
- Fixed graphics resources remaining allocated after particle shader creation failed.
